blocks.text: Jack Begert ’s directorial debut JUNK , starring David Schwimmer , Dominic Fike , Talia Ryder , Jena Malone and Gaby Hoffman is now streaming on Mubi.

Begert, known for directing many a music video for the likes of Olivia Rodrigo, Kendrick Lamar, Jack Harlow, Doja Cat, Dominic Fike and more, describes the film as “a portrait of people caught up in escapism, addiction, and a crisis of meaning.”
